Welcome to **RNR 437/537: Data Wrangling in R for Ecologists**.

This site contains course lessons and assignments organized by topic. Use the sidebar to navigate between topics. Each topic includes a lesson and a corresponding assignment; assignment pages include a link to the answer key.

## Topics

This course covers the following topics in order:

1. [Spreadsheets](Week01_Spreadsheets/Week1_Spreadsheets.qmd)
2. [Introduction to R](Week02_IntrotoR/Week2_IntrotoR_Instructor.qmd)
3. [Vectors](Week02_IntrotoR/Week2_Vectors_Instructor.qmd)
4. [Data Tables and Pipes](Week03_DataTables/Week3_DataTables_Instructor.qmd)
5. [Groups and Joins](Week04_Groups_and_Joins/Week4_Vectors_and_DataFames_Instructor.qmd)
6. [Data Visualization](Week05_DataViz/Week5_DataVisualization_Instructor.qmd)
7. [Tidy Data](Week06_TidyData/Week6_TidyData_Instructor.qmd)
8. [Dates and Strings](Week07_DatesandStrings/Week14_DatesandTimes_Instructor.qmd)
9. [Solving Bigger Problems](Week08_SolvingBiggerProblems/Week7_SolvingBiggerProblems_Instructor.qmd)
10. [Reproducibility and File Paths](Week08_Reproducibility/scripts/Week8_Reproducibility_Instructor.qmd)
11. [Version Control](Week10_VersionControl/code/Week10_VersionControl.qmd)
12. [Functions](Week11_Functions/Week11_Functions_Instructor.qmd)
13. [Making Choices](Week12_MakingChoices/Week12_MakingChoices_Instructor.qmd)
14. [Iteration](Week13_Iteration/scripts/Week13_Iteration_Instructor.qmd)
15. [Geospatial Data](Week14_GeospatialData/Week14_GeospatialData_Instructor.qmd)
